systems.behavior: Use the passed FNAF 1 folder and Steam manifests for the five related games; load each real executable icon in memory; never copy source-game files.

Start with $200 and Freddy unlocked. Buy catalog items in four rating-unlocked tiers, place them on the blueprint, and earn placed-cost/4 plus guest and bonus-revenue income after surviving. Two fixed dining tables each block two floor tiles. Paper Cups and Plates automatically sit on both tables; Sanitation Station sits beside the stage. Both fixtures count toward ratings and payout without using floor tiles. Atmosphere adds $2 per point, entertainment $3, bonus revenue $10. Health & Safety offsets liability risk; three 1-in-50 rolls per risk point can each trigger a $100 lawsuit. A Konami code grants $1,000.

Run a task-driven office shift on a one-second clock with an 8:55 maximum. Completing all 11 supply, advertising, and maintenance tasks ends the shift; each task advances the clock by three extra seconds. Tasks last 12, 20, or 17 seconds by category. Threats follow camera paths and move on periodic opportunities with AI/20 odds; Freddy checks every three seconds; other roster threats check every five seconds. Bonnie follows the FNAF 1 west route to the left door; Chica takes the east-hall route through the kitchen and east hall to the right door. Foxy starts at CAM 1C (Pirate Cove), advances toward the west hall and west corner, and is held back while the player actively checks cameras; shut the left door when his warning appears. Doorway lights reveal threats at the corresponding entrance and closing that door counters their attack. Each staged, owned animatronic active for the night adds a random $1-$10 to a survived-night payout, independently of AI. Freddy is held while the camera monitor is up. The opaque full-office monitor switches between tasks and an 11-camera FNaF 1 map and uses 1 power point per second; camera mode draws one additional point per second. The main-menu control settings remap the monitor and previous/next camera keys. Loud print jobs accelerate animatronic threats. Warnings last a randomized 3-6 seconds. Each missed countermeasure costs 25% of the final payout. The third strike restarts the same day from a saved day-start snapshot, undoing that day's purchases. Staged animatronics above AI 5 each add a linear payout multiplier up to 0.5% at AI 20. Character rosters keep UCN-style 0-20 AI and their own counter-actions.

Either door can close; for every five consecutive seconds a door remains closed, shared power drains by 5 points per closed door. Power recharges 1 point each second while both doors are open and all accessories are off. The raised monitor uses 1 point per second only while raised; camera mode uses 1 additional point per second only while the monitor is raised and cameras are selected; each doorway light uses 1 point per second only while switched on. Lights reveal animatronics waiting at their corresponding doorway. Empty power opens both doors and shuts off the monitor and lights. The office has two vent entrances, and the existing scan action checks for a threat at either vent. Ventilation separately drains during an active vent threat, and the audio lure requires at least 25% ventilation.

Use the user-selected WAVs from sound-bank: main menu theme loops on the title menu; monitor up/down, camera selection, door closing, doorway lights, camera movement, light detection, and jumpscare effects play for their matching events. On victory, play the 6 AM cue followed by the winning-night cue. office ambience2 and the low-volume fluorescent fan loop during the shift and stop on shift end, death, or exit.
Mask counters Toy Bonnie; listening reveals Nightmare Chica before the player blocks the doorway.
After a survived night, present a result and allow the next pizzeria day.
